name: SmartTensors
summary: Framework for unsupervised, supervised, and physics-informed machine learning with matrix/tensor factorization methods.
description: SmartTensors is a framework for science-informed ML/AI using methods such as NMFk and NTFk for feature extraction, model diagnostics, and robust analyses of complex datasets.

name: MADS
summary: Model Analysis and Decision Support framework for calibration, uncertainty quantification, and diagnostics.
description: MADS is an open-source high-performance framework for model inversion, uncertainty quantification, sensitivity analysis, and decision support across environmental and geoscience applications.

name: WELLS
summary: Analytical simulator for multi-well pumping drawdown analysis in confined, unconfined, and leaky aquifers.
description: WELLS simulates pumping and injection well effects using analytical solutions and superposition to support aquifer test interpretation and groundwater decision support.

name: RegAE.jl
summary: Regularized inverse analysis using variational autoencoders for high-dimensional parameter fields.
description: RegAE.jl provides a VAE-based approach for regularizing inverse problems and reducing parameter-space complexity while preserving coherent structures.

name: PhysicsInformedML.jl
summary: Physics-informed machine learning subroutines for integrating scientific constraints into ML workflows.
description: PhysicsInformedML.jl contains reusable subroutines for incorporating physical constraints into learning pipelines and model diagnostics.

name: SVR.jl
summary: Support Vector Regression tools for data-driven regression analysis.
description: SVR.jl provides support vector regression utilities used in model analysis and data-driven prediction workflows.
